hypothesis: A single shared 1000 USDT native wallet may improve full-window net performance by admitting at most one head-and-shoulders auxiliary trade only while NFI is flat, while prioritizing NFI and recording displacement, preemption latency and costs.
motivation: Previously observed original 1000 USDT X8 capacity and already admitted source geometry; independent capital-utilization hypothesis, not a repair selected after new head-and-shoulders financial outcomes.

contract.cost_components: 5 bp commission plus 10/3 bp fee proxy; dataset funding separately; not orderbook slippage evidence
contract.comparison_marks: complete hourly mark OPEN before current bar processing, remaining close fee reserved

1_same_contract_and_flat_admission.nfi_signal_information_clock: Only direction-valid original NFI signal from the completed 5m candle ending at current native time; no future rows. Conservative veto may remain even if later NFI confirm rejects.
1_same_contract_and_flat_admission.simultaneous_auxiliary_priority: Original frozen pair order, no return-based ranking
1_same_contract_and_flat_admission.auxiliary_signal_clock: Original 1h break candle closes at T; project one signal onto 5m row T-5m; native signal shift enters at T only. No forward-filled/retried event.
1_same_contract_and_flat_admission.self_terminal_events: Retain source records; reject native entries

2_native_cash_reservation.budget_B: wallets.get_total_stake_amount() from this one native wallet
2_native_cash_reservation.available_F: wallets.get_available_stake_amount() from this one native wallet
2_native_cash_reservation.fee_f: scenario per-side all-in fee proxy, 0.0015 or 0.0008
2_native_cash_reservation.confirm_after_native_amount_and_minimum_: Require actual margin <= B/6 and actual margin*(1+2*f) <= F-R; otherwise reject, never silently upsizing above cap

3_nfi_preemption.trigger: Any current known direction-valid NFI entry signal in the pool, or any NFI open trade/pending entry
3_nfi_preemption.action: Auxiliary custom_exit requests full exit with independent aux_nfi_priority_preempt reason; keep request active until actual native close
3_nfi_preemption.release_cash: Only actual native fills and wallet update release funds
3_nfi_preemption.same_pair_same_clock_reentry: Reject after auxiliary close at T, including native opposite-direction second-loop reentry; NFI may enter later only if its original later signal independently permits it
3_nfi_preemption.late_auxiliary_entries: Reject T+5m and later; no queue
3_nfi_preemption.costs_and_delays: Record actual entry/exit fees, funding, pending/paused execution, missed NFI signals and altered sizing; no atomic preemption assumption

4_source_dispatch.nfi_enter_tag: Preserve exact original NFI numeric/space tag; do not prefix or rewrite it because source classifies tag.split() using all/any membership
4_source_dispatch.unknown_tag: Reject or separate policy-error exit; never default to NFI
4_source_dispatch.nfi_callbacks: Pass original-tag trades to pinned NFI custom_exit, adjust_trade_position, order_filled, confirm_trade_entry/exit and entry/exit timeout callbacks; preserve their order tags and custom data
4_source_dispatch.auxiliary_callbacks: Independent source-event exit/expiry state, no DCA or partial exit; do not call NFI trade callbacks for auxiliary trades
4_source_dispatch.global_position_adjustment: Enabled for NFI; return None for auxiliary trades

known_interactions: pending orders and historical operation restrictions
5_interaction_and_execution_contract.proposed_minimal_supported_adapter: Main 5m IStrategy derived from pinned NFI; keep global entry/exit limit type. Adapt H&S to native 5m-open limit orders in an explicitly separate frozen policy, using original completed 1h observations. Do not claim existing 1h/market H&S is execution-identical.
5_interaction_and_execution_contract.auxiliary_limit_price: Native proposed current 5m open; no use of intrabar future high/low for signals
5_interaction_and_execution_contract.auxiliary_unfilled_entry: Cancel at first subsequent 5m callback; no delayed event entry; actual operation-rule delays remain recorded
5_interaction_and_execution_contract.alternative_per_source_order_type_extens: Not selected or implemented here; would require a separately frozen native extension and validation
5_interaction_and_execution_contract.native_risk_exits: Keep native -99% catastrophe/liq mechanisms distinct from source target/stop/expiry and policy errors; no claim that source exits remove native risk

mandatory_gates_before_any_combined_fina: Implement a separate version with explicit hashes and actual supported IStrategy/native interfaces; no external account simulator.

Auxiliary-disabled composite must reproduce unchanged NFI signals, tags, fills, DCA/partial exits, fees, funding and full-window native wallet/mark account under the same 1000-USDT cohort and chosen verification tier.
Run and audit a separately frozen H&S-only 5m/limit control using this execution translation before combined financial comparison; the 1h/market interface cannot substitute.

Native lifecycle fixtures must cover tags, source callback dispatch, original NFI order_filled custom data, cash reserve after minimum/precision adjustments, simultaneous 40-pair intents, DCA vs auxiliary cash, all six slots, pending orders, preemption pause/continue/stop, same-clock reverse attempt, source-close availability and expiry.
Freeze actual common native historical rules/funding ownership contract and cost/window before financial execution; new exposure at AXS/TRB unknown funding slots must be independently checked.

Use Configuration -> local Backtesting.start -> actual complete ZIP and one real native wallet; independently reconcile fill quantities, fees, funding, cash and complete endpoint NAV; retain rejects/failures.

Compare combined account with matched NFI-only control; do not add sleeve returns or assume NFI PnL is unchanged. Record source-attributed trades and capacity/cash conflicts as diagnostics, not an independent simulated account.

tier_1_conditional_legacy_model.meaning: Reproducible native engineering and complete account comparison conditional on the explicitly frozen old execution/data model; never certified corrected history
retained_limits: legacy full-month OHLC decimal heuristic can include later monthly observations
historical per-symbol tick/amount/notional/operation effective and known-at coverage not certified for the complete original pool
AXS/TRB 2026-06-24 04:00 UTC funding slots remain UNKNOWN; old accounts have no exposure, but new accounts must recheck
fee proxy and OHLC native fills do not certify exchange execution

tier_2_historical_causal_execution.meaning: Separate stricter gate requiring admitted effective/knowledge clocks and actual reachable rule/funding support, followed by complete native controls and independent account audit

diagnostic_definitions.flat_hours: Count archived hourly rows with open_trades == 0; rows are pre-current-bar processing
diagnostic_definitions.gross_ratio: Quantiles of existing archived gross_ratio column, excluding missing first-row ratio; not free cash or a future DCA budget
diagnostic_definitions.multi_entry_campaign: Native ZIP trade has more than one serialized order with ft_is_entry true
diagnostic_definitions.serialized_max_stake_ratio: Native max_stake_amount divided by first entry amount*safe_price at 1x; native field sums entry notionals without subtracting partial exits, so this is cumulative entry turnover, NOT peak simultaneous capital
diagnostic_definitions.source_candidate_events: v1 source events with earliest_signal_available in inclusive shared comparison window and self_terminal_at_confirmation false
diagnostic_definitions.flat_event_join: many-to-one exact join source earliest_signal_available to archived hourly date; retain only open_trades == 0; report both event rows and distinct clocks
diagnostic_definitions.flat_event_limit: Potential only; distinct clocks are a lower deduplicated count than rows, still an upper bound before max-one auxiliary occupancy, same-clock NFI signals, cash/minimum/dated-rule gates. Neither admitted trades nor profit.
